description: Land Acquisition -  Compensation for the acquisitions of the land in Kandy Four Gravets
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (Wemullawatta, Lot 222) by the government for a water supply project. It details the land's location, extent, and the compensation amount credited to the District Court. The core subject matter is a land acquisition procedure under the Land Acquisition Act, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
